selection.selection: fixed before v2 results; all cases and failures retained
selection.baseline: development3 plus scenario-cleared supplemental S v1
paired_comparisons: v1 vs v2 base: adapter/path generation revision
v2 pursuit additive vs max: matched controller lookahead ablation

metric_rules.cte: independent true rear-axle projection; full RMS/p95 reproduced within 1e-9
metric_rules.moving_mask: absolute true signed speed >=0.5 m/s; no startup exclusion; supplementary only
metric_rules.cruise: stored independent truth cruise RMS after fixed 5s startup allowance
metric_rules.rejoin: count each plan once; False curvature_bound_satisfied is concern; absent in v1 is unassessed
metric_rules.timing: controller_step_ms only, excludes adapter trajectory generation and simulator
metric_rules.coordinates: rigid route-origin transform, initial-forward x and initial-left y; equal axis scale

limits: Diagnostic map routes with privileged references, not leaderboard scores.
One deterministic run per case; no uncertainty estimates or generalization claims.
Moving-mask sample populations can differ; failed short runs are not comparable exposure.
v1 to v2 changes path generation and is not a controller-only causal effect.
